A.depoimento: We marched three spearmen to Santarem, captured the village, and recruited an archer in Lisboa to strengthen our forces.
A.plano: Next turn reinforce Santarem with additional troops, probe Evora for a second foothold, and continue building archers and spearmen in Lisboa to expand our army.

B.depoimento: I raised two spearmen in Barcelona and sent all my troops to conquer Tarragona. The battle should be swift, adding a second village to my realm. My empire begins to grow.
B.plano: After capturing Tarragona, I will have two productive villages. Next turn I will train more units there and prepare to take Girona. I will also scout the road network for hidden enemy forces.

A.depoimento: This turn we marched on Evora, Coimbra and Badajoz, capturing all three with archer and knight forces. We also began producing two more archers in Lisboa to strengthen our army.
A.plano: Next turn reinforce the garrisons of Evora, Coimbra and Badajoz, continue building archers in Lisboa, and scout Faro and Porto for further expansion. Do not send troops from Santarem yet and avoid building knights until iron reserves recover.

B.depoimento: This turn I recruited two spearmen in Barcelona and launched the full Tarragona garrison against Girona. I expect to seize the village and expand our control.
B.plano: After capturing Girona, we will have three villages. Next turn we will train more units in Barcelona and the new village, and prepare to take Castellon or Zaragoza. We will also keep scouting for enemy forces.

A.depoimento: This turn I captured Faro, Porto, and Sevilha. Lisboa sent three archers to Faro and a spearman‑knight squad to Porto, while Badajoz deployed its two knights against Sevilha. All attacks succeeded, raising my held villages to eight.
A.plano: Next turn rebuild Lisboa with a knight, train two spearmen in Santarem, produce archers in Evora and Coimbra, and reinforce the garrisons of Faro, Porto, and Sevilha. Prepare to attack Salamanca and Toledo using spearman‑archer combos for counter advantage.

B.depoimento: We built an archer in Barcelona and two spearmen in Tarragona, then sent Barcelona's spearmen to reinforce the assault on Girona.
B.plano: After capturing Girona, we will have three villages. Next turn we will train more units in Barcelona and the new village, and prepare to take Castellon or Zaragoza. We will also keep scouting for enemy forces.

B.depoimento: This turn we sent spearmen to Castellon, a knight to Zaragoza, and archers to Huesca, aiming to seize all three neutral villages. We held our forces in Barcelona and began training reinforcements. Our villages are ready to grow.
B.plano: Next turn: consolidate captured villages, build more knights in Barcelona and Tarragona, and prepare to push toward enemy capital. Keep scouting beyond newly taken lands. Do not split forces too thin; maintain garrisons of at least 5 troops per village.

B.depoimento:
Sent knights to Huesca and spearmen to Barcelona and Tarragona.
Built knights in Barcelona and Tarragona, an archer in Girona.
Preparing to strike east toward enemy capital.
B.plano:
Next turn: attack Zaragoza with knights from Huesca.
Use reinforced Barcelona and Tarragona for defense.
Continue building knights and archers.
Keep scouting beyond newly taken lands.

A.depoimento: This turn I focused on building up my army, producing knights and archers in every village to strengthen our forces for future offensives.
A.plano: Next turn, deploy knight-heavy forces to capture nearby neutral villages, starting with Salamanca and Vigo, to expand our territory toward the 18-village victory condition.

B.depoimento: I trained knights in Barcelona and Tarragona, archers in Girona, spearmen in Castellon, and sent two knights from Huesca to take Zaragoza.
B.plano: Next turn: reinforce Zaragoza if captured, defend new holdings, continue producing knights and archers, and scout Valencia and Pamplona for future attacks.

A.depoimento: I ordered archers to be trained in most of our villages and a spearman in Porto, while sending Toledo's two knights to seize Cordoba. This strengthens our forces and begins the push toward the enemy capital.
A.plano: Next turn, Cordoba should be ours with a knight garrison. Use newly built archers to reinforce Faro and Porto for Sevilha and Vigo pushes. Gather knights at Toledo and Badajoz for Teruel and Madrid.

B.depoimento: This turn I trained new knights and archers across my realms and sent a detachment from Tarragona to strengthen Zaragoza. My forces grow while I keep the frontier secure.
B.plano: Reinforce Zaragoza with troops from Tarragona; continue building knights and archers in all villages; hold current lines and prepare to scout Valencia and Pamplona for future attacks; avoid overextending by not launching major assaults this turn.

A.depoimento: This turn we seized Vigo, Sevilha, Murcia, Salamanca, and Teruel, expanding our control to 14 villages. We used archers to counter spear garrisons and spears+knights to counter knight garrisons. Our forces are now positioned for further expansion.
A.plano: Next turn, aim to capture Madrid and remaining neutrals using spears for counter. Build archers and spears to replenish forces. Avoid overextending; keep garrisons in newly taken villages.

B.depoimento: Sent three knights from Barcelona to Madrid, four archers from Castellon to Valencia, and three knights from Zaragoza to Pamplona. Built new troops in all villages to strengthen economy and defenses.
B.plano: Capture Madrid, Valencia, and Pamplona this turn using knights and archers. Build additional knights and archers to reinforce holdings and prepare for further expansion. Keep sufficient garrison in each village to defend against enemy counters.

A.depoimento: This turn we fortified our borders by building spearmen in all our villages, sent troops to take Vigo and Murcia, and reinforced Salamanca. Our armies won at Salamanca and Sevilha, expanding our control to twelve villages.
A.plano: Next turn, capture Vigo and Murcia; reinforce Salamanca and Sevilha with arriving troops; continue building spearmen to counter enemy knights; prepare assault on Madrid from Salamanca and Toledo; avoid spreading forces too thin.

B.depoimento: I launched attacks on Valencia, Burgos, and Pamplona with mixed forces, leaving small garrisons. I built archers in Barcelona, Tarragona, Huesca and knights in Girona and Castellon. My troops will arrive next turn to secure these villages.
B.plano: Capture Valencia, Burgos, and Pamplona next turn. Build archers and knights to reinforce holdings. Keep minimal garrisons in Castellon, Madrid, and Huesca. Avoid attacking Salamanca this turn due to incoming enemy reinforcement.

A.depoimento: I sent spearmen from Toledo to bolster the attack on Teruel and to claim Madrid, while a spearman and archer from Vigo took Burgos. I also built spearmen and archers across my realms to strengthen my army.
A.plano: Next turn, secure Teruel, Burgos, and Madrid with the forces en route; reinforce Salamanca and Sevilha with arriving archers and knights; continue building spearmen to counter enemy knights; keep a defensive garrison in Vigo and avoid overextending.

B.depoimento: We sent archers to seize Murcia and marched spears and knights to fortify Madrid for an upcoming attack on Toledo. Meanwhile, we began building archers and knights in our interior villages to replenish our forces. No troops were sent to Teruel to steer clear of enemy reinforcements.
B.plano: Capture Murcia and reinforce Madrid for a future strike on Toledo. Keep strong garrisons in Zaragoza and Valencia. Avoid Teruel this turn due to incoming enemy reinforcements.

A.depoimento: Built spearmen in all villages. Sent forces to take Teruel and Madrid. Marched troops from Toledo and Sevilha to strengthen Cordoba for a future Murcia attack. Sent Vigo's knight to Burgos for defense. Kept modest garrisons in Salamanca and Burgos.
A.plano: Next turn, use reinforced Cordoba to capture Murcia. Hold Madrid and Teruel against enemy counterattacks. Keep garrisons in Salamanca and Burgos ready. Do not overextend by attacking Pamplona yet.

B.depoimento:
This turn I massed my forces toward Madrid, sending spearmen and knights from Zaragoza, Pamplona, Huesca, Barcelona, Tarragona, and Girona.
I dispatched a spearman to Teruel and a knight to Murcia to capture those neutral villages.
I ordered construction of knights and archers in all my villages to replenish my armies.
B.plano:
Fortify Madrid with all available reinforcements to withstand the incoming enemy army.
Launch simultaneous attacks on Teruel and Murcia to expand our territory.
Build knights and archers to replace sent troops.
Do not split forces to attack Burgos this turn.

A.depoimento: Statement: This turn we mustered new troops across our realms and sent archers toward Murcia and knights toward Pamplona. Our borders hold firm while we prepare for the next push.
A.plano: Plan: Secure Murcia and Pamplona this turn to raise our village count to 15. Continue building spearmen and archers in interior villages for future offensives. Avoid attacking Madrid or Teruel until we have a stronger force. Keep garrisons in Salamanca, Toledo, and Burgos ready for enemy counterattacks.

B.depoimento: Built 2 archers in Madrid. Sent 2 archers to attack Toledo. Held all other positions.
B.plano: After capturing Toledo, garrison it with troops from Madrid and Valencia. Continue building archers and knights to prepare for attacks on Salamanca or Burgos. Keep defenses strong in Madrid and Teruel.

A.depoimento: Our forces took Valencia, Zaragoza, and Huesca this turn. We reinforced interior villages with new spearmen. Our front lines hold.
A.plano: Capture Valencia, Zaragoza, Huesca to reach 18 villages. Keep garrisons in Salamanca, Toledo, Burgos ready for enemy counterattacks. Do not attack Madrid or Teruel until stronger.

B.depoimento: This turn I raised fresh knights and archers in my cities, then launched decisive strikes to capture Salamanca, Burgos, Toledo, and Pamplona, while reinforcements from Girona march to bolster Madrid.
B.plano: Consolidate gains by securing Burgos, Toledo, Salamanca, Pamplona. Next turn, prepare to take Murcia and Vigo using forces from Valencia and Burgos. Maintain garrisons in all border villages to prevent enemy counterattacks.

A.depoimento: I ordered a massive knight buildup across my realms and sent Burgos's spearman and archer to seize Pamplona, hoping to expand my territory.
A.plano: Next turn, use newly built knights to attack Valencia, Madrid, and Teruel. Keep garrisons strong in border villages. Continue building troops for future pushes.

B.depoimento: This turn I sent forces to seize Murcia, Burgos, Toledo, and Salamanca, successfully expanding my realm. I ordered spearmen production across my villages to prepare for future campaigns. Pamplona remains secure as a forward base.
B.plano: Consolidate gains by garrisoning captured Murcia, Burgos, Toledo, Salamanca. Build spearmen in all villages to replenish forces. Next turn, advance from Burgos to take Vigo and use new bases to explore north-west. Avoid over-extending; keep at least one troop in each home village.

A.depoimento: This turn I sent armies to capture Madrid, Teruel, and Murcia. I built archers in most of my villages and knights in Toledo and Cordoba to boost offensive power. My border villages held against enemy attacks.
A.plano: Next turn, reinforce Madrid, Teruel, and Murcia with fresh troops. Prepare to launch an attack on Burgos from Madrid. Continue building archers and knights in interior villages. Keep border garrisons strong to resist enemy counterattacks.

B.depoimento: This turn I directed every village to produce spearmen, stockpiling for future offensives. No armies were sent as we prioritize consolidation and buildup.
B.plano: Continue building spearmen in all villages to reach sufficient numbers for a counter attack on Toledo. Keep at least one troop in each home village as garrison. Prepare to launch spearmen from Teruel or Madrid toward Toledo in two turns.

A.depoimento: Launched an attack on Murcia from Cordoba with six spearmen, one archer, and two knights. Sent knight reinforcements from Lisboa, Santarem, Evora, Coimbra, Badajoz, Faro, Porto, Sevilha, Vigo, and Madrid to Toledo. Sent additional knights to Cordoba for defense. Built knights and archers in all interior villages to increase troop production.
A.plano: Reinforce Toledo and Cordoba with knights for next-turn attacks. Attack Murcia this turn with Cordoba troops to gain a village. Build knights and archers in interior villages to boost production. Avoid attacking Teruel or Burgos until we have stronger forces.

B.depoimento: This turn, I dispatched two knights from Zaragoza to seize Madrid, expanding our territory. Simultaneously, I ordered the construction of spearmen in every village to bolster our defenses and prepare for future offensives.
B.plano: Continue building spearmen in all villages to increase garrison strength. Next turn, aim to gather enough spearmen in Teruel to launch a successful attack on Toledo. Keep at least one troop in each village as garrison.

A.depoimento: This turn we seized Madrid and Teruel, strengthened Salamanca with fresh knights, and expanded our production by building a knight in each village. Our march continues.
A.plano: Conquered Madrid and Teruel this turn. Reinforced Salamanca with incoming knights for next-turn defense. Built a knight in every village to boost future strength. Next turn aim to take Burgos, Valencia, Zaragoza while holding new gains. Did not attack Burgos or Valencia this turn due to insufficient forces.

B.depoimento: Built spearmen in every village to increase garrison strength. Sent four spearmen from Zaragoza to reinforce Madrid's defenses. Prepared for upcoming offensives on enemy border villages.
B.plano: Continue building spearmen in all villages to boost garrison. Next turn, launch attacks on Murcia from Valencia and Vigo from Burgos with strengthened forces. Keep Madrid reinforced for defense.

A.depoimento: This turn I sent knights from Salamanca to Madrid and from Toledo to Teruel to seize those enemy villages. I built archers in Murcia and Vigo and reinforced interior villages with knights to boost future strength. I held off on attacking Valencia and Burgos due to insufficient forces.
A.plano: Next turn, capture Madrid and Teruel. Build archers in Murcia and Vigo to prepare for Valencia and Burgos. Replenish Salamanca and Toledo with knights. Do not attack Valencia or Burgos yet.

B.depoimento: Ordered construction of two spearmen in each of our villages to bolster future strength. Sent reinforcements from Castellon, Pamplona, and Zaragoza to Valencia, Burgos, Teruel, and Madrid to prepare for upcoming offensives.
B.plano: Reinforce Valencia and Burgos for next-turn attacks on Murcia and Vigo. Continue building spearmen in all villages to increase garrison. Hold interior positions and prepare for further expansion.

A.depoimento: Sent six archers from Santarem to Madrid to prepare a strike on Zaragoza. Built archers in nearly every village to boost production. Trusting Teruel's garrison to repel the incoming enemy force.
A.plano: Next turn, attack Zaragoza with archers from Madrid. Hold Teruel with its knights. Continue building archers in border villages for future assaults on Valencia and Burgos.

B.depoimento: I trained spearmen in every village and sent 18 spearmen from Burgos to take Madrid, hoping to seize this weakly defended enemy hub.
B.plano: Next turn: reinforce Madrid if captured, continue building spearmen in all villages, prepare to attack Teruel or Vigo, and keep strong garrisons at Burgos and Zaragoza.

A.depoimento: This turn I focused on building archers in border villages to strengthen my forces for upcoming offensives, while maintaining defensive positions.
A.plano: Build archers in border villages (Salamanca, Toledo, Vigo, Teruel, Murcia) to stockpile for future assaults. Hold defenses with current troops. Prepare to combine marching archers with new builds for a stronger attack on Madrid next turn.

B.depoimento: I sent a strong force from Valencia to take Teruel, reinforced Madrid with troops from Zaragoza and Burgos, and ordered knights to be built in all our villages for future counter‑attacks.
B.plano: Next turn: check if Teruel fell, keep garrisons at Valencia and Zaragoza strong, continue building knights, prepare to press further into enemy territory if successful.

A.depoimento: We built archers in every village and added spearmen in key interior towns. We sent spearmen to strengthen Salamanca, Toledo, and Vigo garrisons. Our defenses are now stronger while we prepare for future assaults.
A.plano: Stockpile archers in all villages for future offensives. Reinforce border garrisons with spearmen from interior holdings. Do not launch attacks this turn due to travel time delays. Keep sufficient troops inland to defend against possible enemy incursions.

B.depoimento:
We marched Madrid’s force against Salamanca, seeking to seize the village and expand our realm.
At the same time, we ordered archers to be raised in Valencia and Teruel, and a knight in Burgos, to strengthen our counters.
Spearmen are being trained across the interior to replace the troops sent forward.
B.plano:
Next turn: check if Salamanca fell and reinforce Madrid's garrison.
Continue training archers in Valencia and Teruel to counter enemy spearmen.
Keep Burgos' knight ready for a future strike on Vigo.
Avoid splitting attacks; focus on one front at a time.

A.depoimento: Statement: Built two spearmen in each of our villages to increase defensive strength. Sent attack groups to take Madrid from Toledo, Burgos from Vigo, and Valencia from Murcia. Dispatched archers from Coimbra and Porto to bolster Salamanca’s garrison for the coming turn.
A.plano: Plan: Continue building spearmen in all villages for stockpile. Launch attacks on Madrid, Burgos, and Valencia with mixed forces while keeping minimal garrisons. Send archers from Coimbra and Porto to reinforce Salamanca next turn. Avoid sending all troops from border villages to prevent leaving them undefended.

B.depoimento: This turn I ordered Pamplona to train two archers, starting the buildup for a future assault on Salamanca. I held all other positions steady.
B.plano: Continue building archers in Pamplona each turn. Aim to have 5 archers+3 spear ready by turn25 to send to Salamanca. Keep garrisons strong in all villages. Do not launch other attacks this turn.

A.depoimento: Built spearmen in all villages and added archers in Burgos and Valencia. Sent 8 archers from Salamanca and 2 spearmen from Toledo to reinforce the marching army against Madrid, aiming to capture it this turn.
A.plano: Consolidate hold on Madrid after expected capture; prepare attacks on Teruel and Pamplona for next turn; continue building spearmen stockpile; keep garrisons in Salamanca and Toledo sufficient; avoid sending all troops from border villages.

B.depoimento: This turn I trained an archer in Pamplona and four spearmen in Madrid, then marched Zaragoza’s garrison to reinforce Madrid against the incoming enemy army.
B.plano: Continue building archers in Pamplona each turn; aim for 5 archers+3 spear by turn25 to send to Salamanca. Keep garrisons strong, especially Madrid after reinforcement. Do not launch other attacks this turn.

A.depoimento: I marched a mixed force from Lisboa to take Teruel and sent a lone archer from Madrid to seize Zaragoza. Spearmen production continues across the realm while border villages stay ready for enemy replies.
A.plano: Capture Teruel and Zaragoza to reach 18 held villages. Keep Lisboa garrison strong with remaining spears, preserve Madrid's archers for defense, and continue spearmen buildup everywhere. Avoid attacks on Pamplona or Castellon due to insufficient force.

B.depoimento: This turn I recruited two archers in Pamplona and redirected all available forces from Huesca and Girona’s knights to Zaragoza, fortifying our border against the impending enemy push toward Madrid.
B.plano: Continue building archers in Pamplona each turn; aim for 5 archers+3 spear by turn25 to send to Salamanca. Strengthen Zaragoza garrison with incoming troops; prepare to attack Madrid next turn once Zaragoza holds >30 troops. Do not launch other attacks this turn.

A.depoimento: This turn I sent forces from Lisboa and Cordoba to Zaragoza, and from Evora to Teruel. Both attacks succeeded, capturing the villages and bringing our total to 18 held villages. We are now one turn away from victory.
A.plano: Next turn: defend newly captured Teruel and Zaragoza. Reinforce Teruel with the arriving march from Lisboa. Build spearmen in Lisboa, Cordoba, and Evora to replace losses. Keep interior garrisons strong and avoid overextending.

B.depoimento: This turn I marched spear from Teruel to Zaragoza to bolster our attack force, while sending infantry from Castellon, Pamplona, and Tarragona to fortify Teruel. I ordered three knights to be built in Teruel and one archer in Pamplona to follow our archer‑building plan. These moves prepare us to seize Madrid next turn and hold Teruel against the incoming enemy army.
B.plano: Turn26: Send Zaragoza spear to capture Madrid. Continue reinforcing Teruel with incoming troops from Castellon, Pamplona, Tarragona. Finish building knights in Teruel for counter bonus. Do not split forces; focus on securing Madrid and defending Tarragona.

A.depoimento: This turn we reinforced Teruel with troops from Toledo and Valencia while preserving Valencia's defense. We also began building spearmen in key inland villages to replace losses and strengthen our position.
A.plano: Next turn: defend Teruel with arriving forces; keep Valencia garrison; build spearmen in Lisboa, Cordoba, Evora; hold interior; avoid overextending.

B.depoimento: This turn I ordered massive archer production across my realms and dispatched spear columns to bolster Teruel and Zaragoza against enemy advances.
B.plano: Build archers in all villages to prepare for attacks next turn. Send spear reinforcements to Teruel and Zaragoza to defend against incoming enemy armies. Do not launch attacks this turn due to insufficient archers. Keep resources focused on production and defense.

A.depoimento: I recruited spearmen across my realm and dispatched a knight‑heavy force from Teruel to capture Castellon.
A.plano: Next turn: defend Teruel against incoming enemy armies; keep garrison strong; continue building spearmen in interior villages; prepare to seize another enemy settlement.

B.depoimento: This turn I ordered archers built in every village to boost future firepower. I sent a mixed force of archers and knights from Castellon to capture Valencia. I redirected all available troops from Tarragona, Girona, Huesca, Pamplona, and Barcelona to reinforce Zaragoza against the incoming enemy threat.
B.plano: Plan: Secure Valencia this turn, fortify Zaragoza with all available troops, continue archer production everywhere. Next turn, prepare to defend against enemy armies heading to Zaragoza and Teruel, and consider a stronger assault on Teruel with archers and knights. Do not split forces unnecessarily; keep garrisons sufficient to hold captured villages.

B.depoimento: I strengthened Castellon and Zaragoza, sent a powerful archer force to take Teruel, and ordered mass archer production across my realms. Pamplona’s garrison is deliberately light to concentrate on the offensive, accepting temporary vulnerability for a decisive push.
B.plano: Reinforce Castellon and Zaragoza, launch archer-heavy attack on Teruel to exploit spear counter, mass-produce archers everywhere. Keep Pamplona’s garrison thin to focus on the front lines; accept short‑term risk. Do not split forces excessively, avoid building knights where wood is scarce, and do not send Girona’s troops this turn.

A.depoimento: We dispatched troops from Valencia, Murcia, Badajoz, and Madrid to bolster Castellon and Teruel against the approaching enemy forces. Our interior villages remain secure.
A.plano: Hold our 18 villages. Send reinforcements to Castellon and Teruel to stop enemy marches. Keep garrisons strong. No need to attack; just defend.

B.depoimento: Built an archer in each of our six villages. Sent twelve archers from Zaragoza to capture Madrid. Sent seven spears from Girona to bolster the Castellon front. Marched forces continue to advance.
B.plano: Secure Madrid this turn; reinforce Girona's spear line for Castellon; continue archer production in all villages; prepare to assault Burgos or Teruel next turn with accumulated archers; keep Zaragoza as main production hub.

B.depoimento: This turn I trained archers in every village, sent two archers from Castellon to seize the undefended Valencia, and dispatched five spearmen from Zaragoza to bolster Castellon's defenses against the approaching enemy host.
B.plano: Capture Valencia this turn to expand territory; reinforce Castellon with Zaragoza spearmen and hold against the incoming enemy army; continue archer production in all villages to build a strong ranged force; avoid splitting Zaragoza's garrison too thin; do not attack Teruel or Burgos until we have overwhelming archer numbers.
